title: [Deferred by ruling] Unify flow field-expression assignment onto the CEL engine — the B half of the #11060 ruling, awaiting maintainer appetite
body:
Filed by the triage seat as the ruled follow-up of #11060 (maintainer 2026-08-23, live PM chat, verbatim: 「其他同意你的意见」— adopting "A now + B follow-up on hold pending appetite").

## What this card is

#11060's ruled option A ships the six-function table (`round`/`floor`/`ceil`/`abs`/`min`/`max`, semantics mirrored from CEL) to unblock the quote flow. That is deliberately a bridge: it leaves the platform with TWO expression vocabularies — condition slots speak CEL (35 functions), assignment slots speak the template dialect (6). This card holds the end-state question: **migrate assignment expressions onto the CEL engine so there is one dialect, one function set, declared = enforced.**

## Why it is on hold rather than queued

The migration cost is real and unmeasured — the `{var}` template dialect's compatibility surface across existing flows was the recorded confidence gap in #11060's analysis. Scheduling it is an appetite call the maintainer explicitly deferred.

Restart-when: closed objectstack-ai/objectstack#11060

(When A lands and #11060 closes, the unlock scan returns this card to the decision inbox for an appetite ruling — with A's landed shape and the by-then-measurable `{var}` dependency surface as inputs. ⛔ Do not implement from this card without that second ruling.)

Refs: #11060 (ruling + analysis) · hotcrm#1206 (the measured business pull).
